title: Coin-Ops instance map
description: Named VM instances and their per-host overrides. Keys under instances are resource names used by Terraform and Ansible inventory.

instances.description: Map of instance name to VM configuration.

subnet.description: Subnet key from networks.json where the instance should be placed.

role.description: Functional host role used by Terraform outputs and Ansible grouping.

has_public_ip.description: Whether this instance receives a public IP address.

instance_size.description: Logical instance size resolved through cloud_mappings.json.

disk_size.description: Boot disk size in GiB for this instance.

can_ip_forward.description: Whether the VM can forward packets, usually for jump/NAT hosts.

image_profile.description: Optional per-host image profile from cloud_mappings.json.

clouds.description: Clouds where this instance should exist. Missing means default_instance_clouds from clouds.json.
